 Pumas UNAM 1 – 1 Live 22' Club América Live Updated a few seconds ago Pumas vs Club America LIVE, Score Updates, Liga MX Clasico Capitalino (1-1)
 Follow Pumas UNAM vs Club América live score at Estadio Olímpico Universitario, goals, team news, lineups, text commentary & Liga MX 2026 stats on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Gabriel Garcia Updated November 7, 2026, 10:34 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 10:34 PM ET 22' 10:34 PM ET a few seconds ago The game has heated up!
 The game has heated up! Things have really gotten intense, and players from both teams have gotten into a scuffle at midfield and are trading insults. Huerta, Morales, and Álvarez got into a scuffle that involved shoving; the referee showed yellow cards, and the play is being reviewed by VAR.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Key moments
 10:16 PM ET 4' Goal · Pumas UNAM 1-1 
 10:14 PM ET 3' Goal · Club América 0-1 
 10:10 PM ET 1' The game is underway! 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 19' 10:29 PM ET 5 minutes ago That one was for Pumas!
 That one was for Pumas! During an attacking transition set up by Junihno, Morales, and Antuna, the latter two failed to connect and squandered the chance. They’re not sharp on set pieces, while América is playing in their own box and defending.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 15' 10:26 PM ET 8 minutes ago The pace and intensity of the game have gradually
 The pace and intensity of the game have gradually slowed down; so far, América has continued to dominate, although Pumas aren't giving up, and whenever they regain possession, they launch quick counterattacks down the wings.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 11' 10:21 PM ET 13 minutes ago The game continues with high intensity
 The game continues with high intensity; both teams understand that this is a classic rivalry, and América is moving the ball forward more effectively, but Pumas are preventing them from finding open spaces, and when they get the chance, they look to launch quick counterattacks.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8' 10:18 PM ET 16 minutes ago What a start to the game we're having.
 What a start to the game we're having. Two goals in just five minutes, and the game is gradually picking up speed. For now, América is in control and trying to keep the ball away from the home team so they can't get it and attack them.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 4' 10:16 PM ET 18 minutes ago Goal!, Goal!, Goal!, Goal for the Pumas!
 Goal!, Goal!, Goal!, Goal for the Pumas! A give-and-go between Juniho and Antuna; Uriel reaches the end line and sends in a precise cross that Huerta finishes off beautifully—the ball goes in right next to the post. The game got off to a flying start!
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 3' 10:14 PM ET 21 minutes ago Goal!
 Goal!, Goal!, Goal!, Goal for América. The Águilas strike first after a great play by Pérea, who sends a cross to the far post, where Zendejas jumps to head it in and open the scoring.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 1' 10:10 PM ET 24 minutes ago The game is underway!
 The game is underway! The capital city derby is now being played at the Estadio Olímpico Universitario. We're expecting a great show in Mexico City between these two great teams. Stay tuned to this broadcast so you don't miss a thing!
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:08 PM ET 26 minutes ago Everything’s ready at the Olímpico Universitario!
 The players are already on the field to go through the pre-game protocol! Pumas and América are getting ready to face off in another edition of the Clásico Capitalino, with crucial goals at stake in this final stretch of the season.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:05 PM ET 30 minutes ago A Rematch After the Quarterfinals
 This matchup also serves as a rematch of the 2026 Clausura quarterfinals, when Pumas eliminated América after two 3-3 draws. Pumas advanced to the semifinals thanks to their higher position in the overall standings, knocking the Águilas out of the tournament.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:02 PM ET 32 minutes ago América's Starting XI
 The Águilas have also announced their starting lineup for the away game at Ciudad Universitaria. Here are the eleven players Guillermo Almada is starting:
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:59 PM ET 35 minutes ago Pumas' Starting XI
 The university team has already finalized its starting lineup; here are the 11 players Esteban Solari will field from the start:
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:50 PM ET 44 minutes ago Pumas and América Arrive at the Stadium
 The squads from both teams are already at the Estadio Olímpico Universitario to finalize preparations before the match. Pumas are coming into the game on a high after a 2-1 road win over Puebla, while América are coming off a 2-2 draw against Toluca.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:46 PM ET an hour ago The Olympic University Stadium, Ready for the Capital Derby
 Everything is set at Ciudad Universitaria to host one of the most anticipated matches of the day. The Olympic University Stadium will be the scene of a showdown in which Pumas’ playoff hopes and América’s lead in the standings are on the line.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:38 PM ET an hour ago We're back
 The Clásico Capitalino is coming up! Pumas and América face off at the Estadio Olímpico Universitario in a match for Matchday 16 of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura. Two teams with important goals meet in a new edition of this rivalry: the Pumas are looking to close in on a playoff spot, while the Águilas need to defend their lead in the standings.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:38 PM ET an hour ago Follow Pumas vs América Live Score with VAVEL!
 We'll soon share the starting lineups for the Pumas vs América match live, along with the latest updates from the Estadio Olímpico Universitario. Don't miss a single detail of the live match updates and commentary from VAVEL's coverage.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:38 PM ET an hour ago A rematch following an elimination in the Liguilla
 This Clásico Capitalino has a recent history that adds a special twist. Pumas and América faced off in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Clausura, a series that ended with two 3-3 draws. Although neither team managed to win over the course of the 180 minutes, Pumas advanced to the semifinals thanks to their higher position in the overall standings.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:31 PM ET an hour ago Henry Martín Is on a Roll and Comes into the Match After Scoring Two Goals
 Henry Martín is once again emerging as one of the players who can make a difference for América. The Mexican forward scored both goals in his team’s 2-2 draw against Toluca in the previous matchday. He’s on a roll and will be the player to watch for Guillermo Almada’s team, especially if they want to stay at the top of the standings.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:00 PM ET 2 hours ago Juninho, a Threat for Pumas
 Juninho will be one of the players to watch for Pumas in this matchup. The forward will be responsible for bringing mobility and presence to the final third, complementing his attacking teammates. The Brazilian comes into the game after scoring a goal against Puebla in last week’s 1-2 victory.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Head-to-Head Record Between Pumas and América
 The last five matchups between Pumas and América have been marked by mixed results and several games decided by the narrowest of margins. During that span, América secured two victories, Pumas won once, and the other two matches ended in draws. However, those draws had one thing in common: both occurred in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Clausura and ended with the same score, 3-3.
 Prior to those matches, Pumas had secured a 1-0 victory over América in March 2026. The trend shifted in the two previous encounters: América won 4-1 in September 2025 and also prevailed 2-0 in February of that year.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:35 PM ET 3 hours ago University Olympic Stadium
 The Pumas vs América game will be played at the University Olympic Stadium, located in Mexico City, Mexico. This stadium, which opened in 1952, has a capacity of approximately 72,000 spectators. It is one of the most iconic venues in Mexican sports and the home of the UNAM Pumas, as well as part of the architectural heritage of Ciudad Universitaria.
 The stadium hosted the 1968 Mexico City Olympic Games and has been the site of many major sporting events.
 For the Pumas, playing at this venue means having the support of their fans and defending a field that is part of their identity; they’ll have to play well to move closer to the playoff zone. For América, it will be a challenging away game, in an atmosphere that tends to give each edition of the Clásico Capitalino a special feel.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:10 PM ET 3 hours ago How to watch Pumas UNAM vs Club América Live Stream, TV Channel & Kick-off Times
 Here are the official kick-off times, TV channels and live stream options to watch Pumas UNAM vs Club América in Liga MX across major English-speaking regions:
 USA: 10:10 PM EST / 7:10 PM PST - TV & Live Stream on ESPN+, Paramount+, Peacock, fuboTV .

 Australia & New Zealand: 2:10 PM AEDT (4:10 PM NZDT in New Zealand) - Watch live on Optus Sport, beIN Sports Australia, Stan Sport .
 UAE & MENA (Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Qatar): 7:10 AM GST (6:10 AM AST in Saudi Arabia & Qatar) - Broadcast on beIN Sports English, TOD .
 India, Malaysia & Singapore: 8:40 AM IST (11:10 AM MYT/SGT in Malaysia & Singapore) - Watch on Sony LIV, Star Sports (India), Astro SuperSport (Malaysia) .
 For real-time Pumas UNAM vs Club América live score updates , confirmed starting lineups, match stats and minute-by-minute commentary, follow VAVEL right here.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:10 PM ET 3 hours ago América Defends Its Lead in a Tight Finish to the Tournament
 América arrives at Ciudad Universitaria as the leader of the 2026 Apertura, although its position is under threat. The Águilas have 29 points, the same as Guadalajara and Cruz Azul , but remain in first place thanks to their good differential. The race for the top is very close, and any result could shake up the standings, so Guillermo Almada’s team needs to avoid a slip-up in this final stretch of the championship.
 In their most recent match, the Azulcremas drew 2-2 against Toluca . Henry Martín stole the show, scoring both goals for the Mexico City side and bringing his tournament total to 10 goals. However, the result also meant that América dropped points at a time when their pursuers have the same number of points.
 The visit to Pumas will present an added challenge due to the rivalry and the aftermath of the 2026 Clausura quarterfinals. That elimination remains a part of the recent history between the two clubs, and now América will have the opportunity to respond in a new edition of the Clásico Capitalino.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:10 PM ET 3 hours ago Pumas’ Playoff Hopes Are on the Line
 Pumas heads into this Clásico Capitalino needing points to stay in the hunt for a spot in the playoffs. The university team sits in tenth place with 20 points and knows that its remaining matches will be crucial for closing the gap on the top eight. The victory over Puebla helped restore their confidence, but they still need to maintain that level of play to stay in the race for a playoff spot.
 The 2-1 win against Puebla came after a string of results that had complicated their situation. Before visiting Puebla, the university team tied 1-1 against Tigres and lost 2-0 to Santos. That combination of results made it clear that the team cannot afford too many missteps in the final stretch of the season. The most recent victory was important, though now they will have to prove they can compete against one of the teams fighting for the top spot.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7:10 PM ET 3 hours ago Hello to all VAVEL readers!
 Welcome to the live broadcast of the Pumas vs América match, part of Matchday 16 of Liga MX , taking place at the Estadio Olímpico Universitario.
 My name is Gabriel García, and I’ll be your host for this match. We’ll bring you pre-match analysis, live score updates, and breaking news right here on VAVEL. Follow our live coverage for confirmed starting lineups, real-time score updates, match stats, standings and highlights.
